description: Upright between the bars, motedis' standard M8 core thread at both ends
Top bar, front and back, one piece over all three columns; 4 through holes 8.5 with 14 mm counterbore
Bottom bar, front and back, one piece over all three columns, flush with the bottom depth beams; shares the middle uprights' load with the top plate and top bar; 4 through holes 8.5
Depth beam between the front and the back bar at each upright, the top one flush with the top bars, the bottom one flush with the underside of the bottom bars
Level 1 support, flat leg at the bottom on the bottom bars
Level 2-5 support, flat leg on top, hanging leg guides the box below
Tip guard above level 5, same section and orientation as angle.support

Inside angle bracket 30 for B-type slot 8 (motedis Winkel 30 B-Typ Nut 8): upright to top depth beam (8), top depth beam to bar (8), bottom depth beam to bar on the beam's bay side at the middle uprights (4) and a second one on the other side there (4); at the corners the castor plate joins bottom bar and beam

Castor plate 90x90x8 under each corner, screwed into the bottom slots of the bottom bar and the bottom depth beam; 9 mm hole at 45/45 for the castor bolt, 14 mm hole at 15/15 for the corner bolt head, 4 countersunk holes for M6
ISO 7380 M6x12, 2 per bracket.inside_30 (48) and 1 per bracket.plate (20)
ISO 10642 M6x16 from below through the castor plates into the bottom slots, 4 per plate
Hammer nut M6 B-type slot 8 for the brackets (48), the plate brackets (20) and the castor plates (16)
ISO 10642 M5x12 for the angles, flush in a countersunk hole so the hanging leg stays smooth
Hammer nut M5 B-type slot 8 for the angles
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8x50 from below through the bottom bar into an upright's core thread, 20 mm engaged; at a corner its head sits in the castor plate's 14 mm hole
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8x40 through the top bar into an upright, head sunk in the counterbore, 18 mm engaged
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8x35 from inside the castor housing up through the back hole and the castor plate's 9 mm hole into a lock nut
ISO 7089 (DIN 125 A) washer 8.4, one under the castor bolt's head inside the housing and one under its lock nut on the plate
DIN 985 M8 lock nut on top of the castor plate, holding the castor bolt
Swivel castor 100 mm with total-lock brake (motedis 1748), 125 high, back hole 11, offset 28, 70 kg, under a castor plate at each corner
End cap 30x30 for the ends of the top and the bottom bars
Eurobox NextGen 2.0 Cycle 400x300x120, closed handles, anthracite (C2G43-12)
Eurobox NextGen 2.0 Cycle 400x300x220, closed handles, anthracite (C2G43-22), no inserts
ColorClip set blue, 2 rings (R200-00-02-SET), level 1
ColorClip set turquoise, 2 rings (R200-00-12-SET), levels 2 and 3
ColorClip set light green, 2 rings (R200-00-13-SET), levels 4 and 5
Insert set 1/2 for 400x300x120 (EES43-01-100-04): 2 x NextGen 3613-100
Insert set 1/4 for 400x300x120 (EES43-02-100-04): 4 x NextGen 1813-100
Top plate, birch plywood, grain along the 1114 length, corners rounded R10; structural, screwed to the top bars from below
Angle bracket 30 (motedis Winkel 30 B-Typ Nut 8, as bracket.inside_30), one screw.m6x12_button and tnut.m6 in the top bars' inner slots, 10 per bar at top_plate.mounts.x
Wood screw 4.5x16, pan head, from below through a bracket into a pre-drilled hole in the plate, 1 per bracket; at least 5 mm of wood stays above the tip
